note: Rejudged 2026-10-31 by an auditor who authored none of the change. The only change to test/plugin/role-multiple-roles-notification.ci and role-multiple-same-roles.ci since the last stamp is cabb706c11 moving the policy block from inside bgp {} to the top-level policy root, the same lines re-indented; every action, expect, reject and option line is byte-identical, so the carriers drive the same inputs and assert the same outcomes. Verdict unchanged. RFC 9234 Section 4.2: "If multiple BGP Role Capabilities are received and not all of them have the same value, then the BGP speaker MUST reject the connection using the Role Mismatch Notification (code 2, subcode 11)." The complementary sentence is: "If an eBGP speaker receives multiple but identical BGP Role Capabilities with the same value in each, then the speaker considers them to be a single BGP Role Capability and proceeds [RFC5492]." Producer role/validate.go::validateOpenRolePair compares values, not just the count; server askOpenValidators and session runOpenValidator consume the refusal. role-multiple-roles-notification.ci sends Customer then Peer against Provider, requires exact NOTIFICATION 2/11 and no EoR; Customer alone corresponds, isolating the second differing value. role-multiple-same-roles.ci sends Customer twice, requires EoR and rejects 03020B. TestValidateOpenRolePair_MultipleDifferentRoles pins false, 2/11 and the multiple reason; MultipleSameRoles pins true. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. Functional judgments use the corresponding test/draft/plugin files, not the unpromoted old-syntax live files. Their inactive NO-TRANSIT import/export policies explicitly end in accept; reactor runEgressPolicyChain applies that final only after mandatory in-process OTC, and OPEN validation is independent. This is a source judgment, not a new runtime or discrimination result; parent owns promotion and native freshness before stamping.
